purpose: Independently hand-computed rendered-result cases for the Home Project Calculator Batch A. Expected values are calculated in this file before the browser test is run; do not derive expectations from calculator output.

cases.name: normal metric area, perimeter and volume
boundary zero depth keeps valid area and perimeter but warns volume is zero
cases.handCalculation: 4 m × 3 m = 12 m²; perimeter = 2 × (4 + 3) = 14 m; 12 × 0 = 0 m³. Zero depth is allowed but must not be mistaken for a useful volume.

cases.name: invalid negative depth is rejected
cases.handCalculation: A depth of −0.1 m is physically invalid for this volume calculation. Expected behaviour: show validation and render no result; do not clamp the input to zero.
cases.expectError: Depth or height cannot be negative

cases.name: normal metric wall area and product-label coverage
cases.handCalculation: Room perimeter = 2 × (5 + 4) = 18 m; gross wall area = 18 × 2.5 = 45 m²; net paintable area = 45 − 2 = 43 m²; two coats = 86 m² of coverage; 86 ÷ 10 = 8.6 tin-equivalents; round up to 9 whole tins. No extra allowance is entered.

cases.name: boundary openings equal gross wall area are rejected
cases.handCalculation: 2 × (5 + 4) × 2.5 = 45 m² gross wall area. Openings = 45 m² leaves zero paintable area, so no paint quantity or cost may be shown.
cases.expectError: The openings area must be smaller than the total wall area

cases.name: invalid negative opening area is rejected
cases.handCalculation: An opening area of −1 m² is invalid because an area cannot be negative. Expected behaviour: validation error and no result.
cases.expectError: Check openings, coats, allowance and price

cases.name: normal two-wall free-match roll count
cases.handCalculation: Wall height = 2.4 m; free-match drop length = 2.4 m; each 10 m sale unit provides floor(10 ÷ 2.4) = 4 complete drops. Each 3 m wall needs ceil(3 ÷ 0.53) = 6 drops. Two walls need 12 drops; ceil(12 ÷ 4) = 3 rolls.

cases.name: boundary exact drop capacity uses exactly one roll
cases.handCalculation: One 2.12 m wall with 0.53 m roll width needs exactly 4 drops. A 2.5 m wall height and 10 m sale-unit length provide exactly 4 drops (10 ÷ 2.5 = 4). Therefore exactly 1 roll is required; no extra roll is added at an exact boundary.

cases.name: invalid zero wall width is rejected
cases.handCalculation: A wall width of 0 m is invalid because the calculator requires each entered wall width to be greater than zero. Expected behaviour: show the validation error and no roll count.
cases.expectError: Wall 1 must have a width greater than zero
